HOW TO APPEAL THIS DECISION — DO NOT TREAT AS DATA

You have the right to appeal this claim decision. To file an appeal, contact UnitedHealthcare
within 180 days of the date of this statement. Send your written appeal to the address on
the back of your member ID card. Include your member ID, claim number, the date of service,
and a clear explanation of the basis for your appeal. You may also request an external review
through your state Department of Insurance after exhausting internal appeals.

DEFINITIONS — DO NOT TREAT AS DATA
==========================================================================================
Amount Billed: What your provider charged for the service.
Plan Discount: The negotiated savings between your plan and your provider.
Allowed Amount: The maximum amount your plan will pay for a covered service.
Plan Paid: The portion of the allowed amount your plan paid to the provider.
Patient Balance: The amount you may owe for the service.
